integration.heading: Twitch integration
integration.description: Connect your Twitch account so Streaming Tree can read and update your channel's metadata. No client secret is ever requested or stored.
integration.clientIdHint: Register an application at the Twitch developer console and paste its Client ID here.
integration.clientIdSourceEnvironment: Set by the STREAMING_TREE_TWITCH_CLIENT_ID environment variable and cannot be changed here.
integration.noSecretNote: Streaming Tree never accepts or stores a Twitch client secret - only the public Client ID.
integration.lockedNote: The Client ID cannot be changed while a Twitch account is connected. Disconnect every Twitch account first.

connect.notConfiguredNote: Configure a Twitch Client ID above before connecting an account.

integration.heading: YouTube integration
integration.description: Connect a YouTube channel so Streaming Tree can read and update its live broadcast metadata. No client secret is ever requested or stored.
integration.clientIdHint: In the Google Cloud console: create a project, enable "YouTube Data API v3", create an OAuth client of type "Desktop app", and paste its Client ID here.
integration.clientIdSourceEnvironment: Set by the STREAMING_TREE_YOUTUBE_CLIENT_ID environment variable and cannot be changed here.
integration.noSecretNote: Streaming Tree never accepts or stores a Google client secret, or a downloaded credentials.json file - only the public Client ID.
integration.lockedNote: The Client ID cannot be changed while a YouTube account is connected. Disconnect every YouTube account first.
integration.testingModeNote: If your Google Cloud project is left in "Testing" publishing status, Google expires authorization after 7 days regardless of what Streaming Tree requests - this is a Google limitation Streaming Tree cannot detect or work around, only reconnect after.

connect.notConfiguredNote: Configure a YouTube Client ID above before connecting a channel.

account.heading: Connected YouTube channels
account.reconnectRequiredNote: YouTube could not confirm this channel's access. Reconnect to keep using it.

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect {{login}}?
disconnectDialog.message: Streaming Tree will revoke this channel's access on Google where possible and remove it locally. Any destination linked to it will need to be relinked.

link.heading: Connected YouTube channel
link.description: Linking a YouTube channel lets you read and publish this destination's metadata. It is separate from the destination's stream key.
link.notLinked: No YouTube channel linked to this destination.
link.replaceNote: Linking a different channel replaces the current link.
link.noAccountsAvailable: No YouTube channels are connected yet. Connect one in Settings first.

broadcast.creationNote: Create and schedule a live broadcast in YouTube Studio first - Streaming Tree does not create one for you.
broadcast.staleNote: The previously selected broadcast could not be found. Choose one again.
